lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: Do you want to have lunch with us?
lines.zh: 你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: I had lunch at half past twelve.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: Have a cup of coffee then.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: I've just had a cup, thank you.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: I had one after my lunch.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: Let's go into the living room, Carol.
lines.zh: 我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: We can have our coffee there.
lines.zh: 我们可以在那里喝咖啡。

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
lines.zh: 萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: I've already had my holiday this year.

drills.en: Have some coffee. I've already had ___.
drills.zh: 喝点咖啡吧。我已经喝过了。

drills.en: Have a banana. I've already had ___.
drills.zh: 吃根香蕉吧。我已经吃过一根了。

drills.en: Have some milk. I've already had ___.
drills.zh: 喝点牛奶吧。我已经喝过了。

drills.en: Have an apple. I've already had ___.
drills.zh: 吃个苹果吧。我已经吃过一个了。

drills.en: Has he had any beans or peas? He hasn't had ___ beans.
drills.zh: 他吃过豆角或豌豆吗？他没吃豆角。

drills.en: I've just ___ a cup, thank you.
